description: The supplier may ask once per order for up to 7 more days to ship (order.ship_extension with status 'open'). Approve to accept the new date, or reject to keep the original deadline; if the order then passes it, the buyer may cancel for a full refund. Ask the human unless their instructions already cover it. No answer within 48 hours counts as approval.
name: respond_to_ship_extension
title: Answer a ship-date extension
